title: IMPLEMENTATION OF AI-ENABLED ACADEMIC SUPPORT IN EMRSs
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Tribal Affairs

IMPLEMENTATION OF AI-ENABLED ACADEMIC SUPPORT IN EMRSs

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
22 JUL 2026 4:09PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed Raya Sabha that Medha AI digital platform has been introduced as a two-year program across all functional EMRSs with effect from 22
nd
 June 2026. It is a cloud-based platform that can be accessed from any location with an internet connection.
All EMRSs principals have been empowered across the country including Himachal Pradesh to avail requisite internet connectivity in EMRSs.

The platform will help teachers to prepare lesson plans, presentations, assessments, question banks, and other teaching materials more efficiently. It will also provide students with personalised learning support, practice exercises, doubt-solving tools, and language learning activities. A training module has been designed and circulated among EMRS teachers.
